subject: Okta renewal renegotiation & device-posture pilot — kickoff and asks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anne Fletcher <anne.fletcher@okta.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Okta renewal renegotiation & device-posture pilot — kickoff and asks

Anne —

We’re approaching our contract anniversary (Nov 1). Before the formal renewal window opens, I want to kick off a short negotiation thread to align on: license counts, pricing options for a 3-year commit, and carving out a small device-posture pilot to validate enforcement on managed devices.

Quick summary of what we need from you to get started: 
- A preliminary quote with SKU breakdown (SSO, Adaptive MFA, Device Posture) and multi-year discount tiers.
- Any add-on pricing for increased log retention (audit logs for SSO/MFA) — security will need 1 yr retention for correlation.
- Confirmation of SOC2 report availability and FedRAMP / data residency notes (we’re in the US, but some customers require specific regional controls).
- Can you include a one-page recommended pilot configuration (5–10% seat sample) for device posture enforcement and estimated incremental cost?

I’ve attached our current seat inventory to help you size the quote (redwood_okta_inventory_202507.csv). Karthik (procurement) and Monica (IT ops) are on copy to help scope the pilot and negotiation levers.

Goal: get a baseline quote and pilot plan this week so procurement can formalize negotiation targets. Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff on Aug 4 — does that work for you?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_okta_inventory_202507.csv (CSV inventory — 1.2k active users, 220 contractors, device types included)

From: Anne Fletcher <anne.fletcher@okta.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: okta-licensing@okta.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta renewal renegotiation & device-posture pilot — kickoff and asks

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and the inventory file — that’s exactly what we need to accelerate. I attached a preliminary quote (okta_prelim_quote_20250720.pdf) that shows list pricing and two discount curves (2-yr, 3-yr). Notes: 
- Device Posture (Workplace Security) can be scoped as a pilot at ~8–10% of users with standard seat-level licensing; incremental pricing shown in the doc.
- Audit log retention beyond standard (30 days) is available as an add-on — I flagged 1-year pricing separately.
- SOC2 report link and compliance artifacts are available; I’ll include a secure link once we exchange an NDA (I’ll send via our compliance portal).

Proposed: we can do the Aug 4 10:00 AM PT kickoff. I’ll bring our renewal specialist and a solutions engineer so we can walk the pilot config live.

—Anne
Anne Fletcher
Senior Renewals Manager, Okta
Attachment: okta_prelim_quote_20250720.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta renewal renegotiation & device-posture pilot — kickoff and asks

Jordan / Monica —

I reviewed Anne’s preliminary quote. A few procurement asks to prepare before the kickoff: 
- Target: 10% off list on a 3-yr committed agreement; push for a true TCV discount vs. token-level discounts.
- Ask for a separable pilot SKU with a consumption cap so we can try posture enforcement on a subset without full-seat conversion immediately.
- Request a support retainer pricing option (for premium SE hours during pilot/cutover).
- Confirm termination/exit terms for pilot seats (pro-rated refunds or conversion credits).

Monica — can you validate the inventory CSV for contractor vs. full-time split and flag any seats we want to exclude from the pilot (external contractors, service accounts)? I attached a short procurement checklist (procurement_playbook_notes.txt) with negotiation levers and sample language we’ve used with other vendors.

If legal will need to redline, Laura should be looped before signature. Naomi — can security confirm the retention requirement and whether 1 year is sufficient?

Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement_playbook_notes.txt

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta renewal renegotiation & device-posture pilot — kickoff and asks

Karthik / Jordan —

Quick checks on the inventory: 
- Contractors: 220 (we should exclude them from the initial posture enforcement pilot).
- Service accounts & api-only identities: ~45 (exclude).
- Proposed pilot population: select 9% of active FTEs across three orgs (Platform, Customer Success, Sales) to get a cross-section of device types.

Naomi — 1 year retention is fine for correlation, but security will want the ability to export and archive logs to our long-term store; please confirm S3 export options and any egress costs.

I’ve attached the requested SOW template for Okta to populate; it includes pilot acceptance criteria and fall-back plan.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
IT Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: requested_sow_template.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anne Fletcher <anne.fletcher@okta.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta renewal renegotiation & device-posture pilot — kickoff and asks

Anne —

Thanks for the quick response and the quote. To make the kickoff productive, can you please provide the following by COB Wed (Jul 23):
1) Updated quote: 3-year committed pricing with a TCV discount option and a separable pilot SKU (capable of conversion).
2) One-page pilot runbook (5–10% of FTEs; acceptance criteria, rollback, SE support hours).
3) Compliance artifacts: SOC2 link and a contact for security evidence exchange (we’ll coordinate an NDA if needed).
4) Confirmation on audit log export (S3) and any expected egress or storage charges.

Proposed kickoff: Aug 4, 10:00 AM PT — please share a Teams/Zoom invite and the list of Okta attendees. If the updated quote includes a support retainer option, include pricing and typical response SLAs.

We’re aiming to finalize the commercial structure and pilot SOW in August so engineering can schedule the pilot in Q4.

Jordan Blake
Senior Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
